flow_ref: User story (not in the flow deck; no OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No code for the proceed/reject Letter of Advice decision or its follow-up; only menu labels (0%).
note: Sinonim dicoba di enam repo (UI dan API): letter of advice, LOA, advice, warrant, WOA, warrant of arrest, mention date, court date, court batch, last known address, work item, dashboard, OIC. Tidak ada maintenance ticket yang cocok (grep warrant / letter of advice / court = 0). Status story kosong di data (requirement tidak diberikan); dilacak biasa. CasIntegrationController (CAS-ke-OCMS, casUpdateCourtNotices) ada tetapi bukan fitur ini dan tidak dikreditkan: ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/cas_integration/CasIntegrationController.java:101. Only the menu labels 'Letter of Advice' (ocmsadminui/src/i18n/en/translation.json:122-123) and path constants in System.ts (COURT_BATCH_LIMIT :147, WARRANT_SETTLE_DATE :163), used by no page and with no backend resource. No endpoint, entity or job stores the decision or follows up on the warrant notice based on it. The existing Toppan letter generation is for reminder/DN stages only. Consistent with OCMS27.11 (Letter of Advice decision confirmation = Tidak ada code).
recommendation: Evidence 0%. Do not claim; no Letter of Advice decision feature exists.

steps.step: The officer chooses to proceed or reject sending the Letter of Advice
steps.detail: Only text labels at translation.json:122-123; no button, form or proceed/reject action exists in ocmsadminui.
Only the WARRANT_SETTLE_DATE path constant (System.ts:163-165) with no page using it and no backend resource; no endpoint/entity stores the decision in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi.

steps.step: OCMS follows up on the warrant notice according to the decision (send Letter of Advice or reject)
steps.detail: There is no proceed/reject branch for warrant notices. The existing Toppan letter path advances reminder/DN stages (e.g. ToppanUploadHelper.java:1818), not Letter of Advice; no advice letter template exists.
